notes: Group: Rebel Cell. Portrait site overlay (printed sideways) that RENAMES the site: both bars '•DANTOOINE: BASE - OPERATIONS CENTER' (red • on the Light bar, white • on the Dark bar; spaced hyphen). Light half (right on the slip, grey bar): TWO blue Force sabers → light_force_count 2; text 2 lines. Dark half (left, black bar): ONE red saber (the printed SE card has no Dark Force icon). Icons on both bars, outermost first: scomp ring, planet (pink planet), interior (beige walls) — printed card: planet, exterior, no scomp. INLINE ICON at the end of the Dark text: a small square with a red/pink-edged white slash — matches the Game Aid Dark Side Force icon (g050), not the cyan Light one → {dark-force}; STUB DIFFERS: stub names it a 'Light Side Force icon'. Slip prints a space before the final period ('one [icon] .'). Curly ‘react’. Stub concatenates both halves in one game_text (Dark first). Credits printed across the bottom with the set sphere between: left 'Original concept by Brandon Schele', right 'Corellia Regionals 2005'. BASE: caption names Yavin 4: Massassi Headquarters (SE Light; printed Light text 'May not be separated from interior Yavin 4 sites. If you control, Attack Run total is +2.', Dark '…If you occupy, Attack Run total is -4.'). NOTE: the PC's 2009 VB4 reissue (VB4-L-dantooinebaseoperationscenter-pre.gif) is built on 'Yavin 4: Massassi War Room (V)' with War Room art and shorter text — downloaded as modern, but its art is NOT the Massassi Headquarters art. Scan 490×350 only; SE copyright line by rule. lore '' (site). Art: the printed base card (Bill 2026-10-14); the VB4 reissue has other art.
